summary: First-finish smoke test of Sconti Roma. Backend: all critical endpoints work (public discounts/zones/categories, auth login/register client+merchant, /auth/me with Bearer, subscription mock, redemption create + verify happy path + 400 already-used + 404 wrong-merchant + 402 no-sub, merchant stats). Frontend: landing page loads, login form works via testids login-email/login-password, /discounts renders 6 seeded discounts with working search (pizza -> 1), zone & category filters visible, discount detail redeem-btn produces qr-dialog with redemption-code for subscribed client, merchant navbar shows role-specific links (Dashboard/Il mio sconto/Scansiona/Esci), /merchant/scan verifies invalid code and shows scan-error 'Codice non valido / Codice non trovato'.
passed: GET /api/discounts returns 6 seeded discounts with enriched merchant + percent_off (75%)
POST /api/auth/register (client and merchant) returns access_token + user with role fields
Verify same code twice => 400 'Codice già utilizzato'
Verify code with different merchant (trattoria) => 404 'Codice non trovato'
Redeem without subscription (fresh user) => 402 'Serve un abbonamento attivo'
Client login via UI, discounts page shows 'results-count' 6 sconti trovati
Discount detail redeem-btn opens qr-dialog and shows redemption-code
Merchant login lands on /merchant/dashboard; /merchant/scan works; invalid code triggers scan-error
notes: Payment is intentionally MOCKED (/api/subscription/subscribe always succeeds). All spec'd testids observed: landing-page, login-email, login-password, discount-card-{id}, redeem-btn, qr-dialog, redemption-code, filter-zone, filter-category, search-input, results-count, scan-code-input, scan-verify-btn, scan-error.
